new_today_news.headline: NUERA Notice of Potential Fee Increase
new_today_news.summary: Northern Utah Environmental Resource Agency (NUERA) announced a public hearing on November 16, 2026 to receive input on a proposed tipping fee increase for the Bayview Landfill in Utah County and the 2027 Agency Budget.

new_today_news.headline: Keep FOG Out of Your Drains This Holiday Season
new_today_news.summary: Salisbury-Rowan Utilities issued public guidance on proper FOG disposal to prevent sewer blockages and protect local waterways during holiday cooking season.

new_today_news.headline: 6 Los Angeles Restaurants that Closed Their Doors Permanently in October 2026
new_today_news.summary: Several restaurants across Los Angeles and Santa Monica closed permanently in October 2026, including Japanese-inspired restaurants, bakeries, and wood-fired establishments. The Sycamore Kitchen ended its 15-year run on October 25.

recent_news.headline: Diamond Green Diesel posts strong renewable diesel volumes in third quarter
recent_news.summary: Diamond Green Diesel reported robust third-quarter operating performance, shipping nearly 315 million gallons of renewable fuels. The joint venture between Darling Ingredients and Valero continues to expand production capacity for renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Earnings Results
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental reported $0.19 earnings per share for Q3 2026, meeting analysts' consensus estimates, with revenue of $2.16 billion compared to consensus estimate of $1.49 billion. GFL Environmental reported strong third quarter revenue growth of 27% year-over-year, driven by organic growth and significant contributions from recent acquisitions like Secure and Frontier.

recent_news.headline: Commercial Dump Truck Insurance: 7 Coverages, 2026 Costs
recent_news.summary: Commercial dump truck insurance typically costs $400-$1,200+ per truck per month in 2026, with pricing driven by state, radius, driver experience, job type, limits, deductibles, and claims history. For liquid waste and septic operations, costs trend toward the high end due to pollution and spill liability exposure.

recent_news.headline: Restaurant chains closing hundreds of locations—recent analysis of industry closures
recent_news.summary: Analysis of major restaurant chains closing locations in 2026 due to rising costs and underperformance. Red Lobster has closed 7% of its locations (36 restaurants) in 2026 so far, while O'Charley's permanently shut 49 remaining locations.

recent_news.headline: US-based UCO collector expands compliance to California programmes
recent_news.summary: Neste's subsidiary Mahoney Environmental, a US-based used cooking oil recycler, expanded its sustainability compliance for California programs. The expansion supports Neste's feedstock sourcing strategy for renewable diesel and SAF production.
